Hey Marcus / team,

Thanks again for the runthrough last week. Legal at Medivate wants to do a focused call to walk through our redline set and confirm the onboarding timeline (SOC2 evidence collection + SSO). They'd like a tight session so we don't go multiple rounds — 30–45 mins.

Our preferred windows (PT):
- Tue 19 May — 9:30–10:30am PT
- Tue 19 May — 1:30–2:30pm PT
- Wed 20 May — 11:00–11:45am PT (short slot)

If you can only do longer windows, we can accommodate 60 mins but prefer to keep it focused on the four clauses we highlighted (data retention, access logging, subprocessor flow, liability cap).

2) Attendees: Kimberly (Legal), Marissa (Onboarding lead), me (AM), Lauren (Procurement ops) — please confirm any additional names from your side.
3) Agenda (45m):

   • 25m — redline walk on the 4 priority clauses (share screen and inline PDF comments)
   • 10m — onboarding evidence ask (SOC2, logging, retention) + owner assignment
   • 5m — immediate next steps / DocuSign cadence

Kimberly, can you pre-flag any clauses we should concede or escalate? Marissa — can you confirm the DocuSign/HubSpot mapping so Tom's team gets the onboarding checklist post-call?

If the 1:30 PT slot works for Medivate, I'll send a calendar invite and include a short pre-read (we'll annotate the PDF so the call stays on track).

— Marcus
